title: Weight Update Readiness
plain_reading: Adaptive claims require proof that weights can be changed safely, cheaply, and without wearing out the device.
what_this_supports: The chip can be classified as fixed-weight, rare-update, adapter-update, or adaptive-blocked.
what_this_does_not_prove: A compiler update plan does not prove write endurance or post-update accuracy.
next_actions: Add update metadata to runtime packages.
Block adaptive Physical AI claims until update tests exist.
